Author: Crimson
Name: NIRÆ Tailor
Description: Pick an outfit someone is wearing and port it: from NIRÆ to your FluxHD2 Lalafell (with the outfit's own physics bones), or from another body (Bibo+, Rue+, NeoLithe, YAB, Omoi ...) to NIRÆ with every build, chest, belly and hips option and the body's jiggles. Makes its own Penumbra mod with a Shown / Removed switch for every clothing piece and the outfit's own options, enables it in the collection you pick and redraws. /tailor
Punchline: Port outfits to NIRÆ and to your Lalafell.
